name: WattWise
shortDescription: Home energy analysis: meter imports, configurable tariffs, transparent anomalies, labelled estimates.
features: Interval + cumulative meter readings (unit-consistent kWh, timestamped)
CSV import with duplicate/invalid data-quality reporting (gaps never interpolated)
Versioned configurable tariffs incl. time-of-use windows; transparent bill estimates
Anomaly rule stated in every flag (never proof of a fault)
Naive baseline forecasts labelled ESTIMATE; scenario savings state assumptions
knownLimitations: Solar/device-level breakdown only where data supports it (none in demo)
